taste:
Expect a rich, savoury beef burger with sweetness from ketchup and a sharper edge from the gherkins and mustard. Melting cheese sits over the patty, and the soft bun gives the burger a yielding outer texture. Mustard is described as mild and used sparingly, so the emphasis is on tang rather than a strongly mustard-led flavour.

Served hot with a hearty portion of golden chips, this is a straightforward diner-style plate. Its appeal lies in the contrast between savoury beef, sweet ketchup and tangy toppings, rather than an elaborate combination. Choose it for the classic beef, cheese and pickle combination, with mustard adding a mild tang.
